summary.text: Alexia Unertl is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent David Steffen (R).
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Unertl described herself as a working parent and logistics specialist.

paragraphs.text: Unertl received a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin, Green Bay, in 2011.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she works as a logistics specialist and served as vice-chair of the Brown County chapter of the Wisconsin Conservation Congress.
She sought the Democratic nomination for District 4 in 2024 but was defeated in the primary by Jane Benson, and she advanced from the Democratic primary in 2026.
In the 2024 survey, Unertl said her priorities included reforming school funding, addressing PFAS contamination in groundwater, expanding high-speed internet and creating a public health care option.
